MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The TOGGLER anchors fit my recent drywall anchor purchase because they offer a way to mount heavier fixtures in drywall.",
    "Recommending another mounting fastener made sense alongside my recent screws and nails; it connects to the fastening work I have been buying supplies for."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The pipe fitting, hose clamps and wire locator serve specific jobs I have not shown a need for; being useful repair supplies does not make them useful for my current wood and drywall fastening work.",
    "Caulk and glue address sealing or bonding needs that my screw and nail purchases do not establish, while electronic cleaner and a grooming brush have no clear connection to my current needs.",
    "Buying Panasonic-compatible vacuum bags suggests keeping my existing vacuum running, not needing a new Oreck vacuum."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in tools and maintenance supplies, even though I choose them for particular tasks.",
    "The vacuum recommendation appears to rely on a shared cleaning purpose while overlooking the difference between a compatible replacement supply and a new machine."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated nail, wood screw and drywall anchor purchases give stronger evidence of fastening and mounting needs than of plumbing, wiring or sealing needs.",
    "Exact application and compatibility matter: drywall anchors need to suit the mounting load, and vacuum supplies need to fit the machine I already have."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my fastening needs but stretched them into unrelated maintenance jobs and an unsupported vacuum replacement."
}
